SELECT br.ID, br.TOOL_CODE, t.TOOL_NAME, br.CABINET_NO,
br.USER_ID, br.BORROW_TIME, br.RETURN_TIME, br.STATUS, br.OPERATOR_TYPE, CASE br.STATUS WHEN 'BORROWED' THEN '已借出' WHEN 'RETURNED' THEN '已归还' WHEN 'OVERDUE' THEN '已逾期' ELSE br.STATUS END AS STATUS_NAME FROM BORROW_RECORD br LEFT JOIN TOOL_INFO t ON br.TOOL_CODE = t.TOOL_CODE WHERE br.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY br.BORROW_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT ID, TOOL_CODE, USER_ID, BORROW_TIME, RETURN_TIME, STATUS, OPERATOR_TYPE FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY BORROW_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}

SELECT ID, TOOL_CODE, USER_ID, BORROW_TIME, RETURN_TIME, STATUS, OPERATOR_TYPE, CABINET_NO FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'BORROWED' ORDER BY BORROW_TIME DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND STATUS = 'BORROWED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE STATUS = 'BORROWED'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM BORROW_RECORD WHERE TOOL_CODE = #{toolCode} AND STATUS = 'BORROWED'
